ei.title: 함축의미 — the boost is grounded in fiction
ei.subject: 6월 고3 모의고사
ei.lesson: 함축의미 — the boost is grounded in fiction

fullPassage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only slightly difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in fiction.

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of (A)[external / internal] factors. These factors may be random and (B)[misleading / reliable]. Comparison is one source of (C)[illusion / truth]. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only slightly difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in fiction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 외부(external) 요인에 좌우됨. 이 요인은 오해를 유발(misleading). 비교는 착각(illusion)의 원천.
det.analysis:
① internal — misleading — illusion: internal 오류 ←A 불일치
② external — misleading — illusion: 원문 일치 ←정답
③ external — reliable — illusion: reliable 오류 ←B 불일치
④ external — misleading — truth: truth 오류 ←C 불일치

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only (A)[slightly / extremely] difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, (B)[objectively / subjectively], you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially (C)[favorable / unfavorable] conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in fiction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 약간(slightly) 어렵다고 느낌. 객관적으로(objectively) 강한 성과. 유리한(favorable) 조건.
det.analysis:
① slightly — objectively — unfavorable: unfavorable 오류 ←C 불일치
② extremely — objectively — favorable: extremely 오류 ←A 불일치
③ slightly — subjectively — favorable: subjectively 오류 ←B 불일치
④ slightly — objectively — favorable: 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you (A)[mastered / failed] your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 목표를 달성(mastered). 공로를 인정받을(credit) 수 있는 것이 아님. 자존감 부양은 허구(fiction)에 기반.
det.analysis:
① mastered — credit — reality: reality 오류 ←C 불일치
② failed — credit — fiction: failed 오류 ←A 불일치
③ mastered — credit — fiction: 원문 일치 ←정답
④ mastered — blame — fiction: blame 오류 ←B 불일치

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and ①<u>accurate</u>. Comparison is one source of ②<u>illusion</u>. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only ③<u>slightly</u> difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, the boost is grounded in ④<u>fiction</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① accurate(정확한)는 원문 misleading(오해를 유발하는)이어야 한다. 외부 요인은 무작위이고 '오해를 유발'할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
① accurate → misleading: 정확한이 아닌 오해를 유발 ←정답
② illusion: 원문 일치 — 비교는 착각의 원천
③ slightly: 원문 일치 — 약간 어려움
④ fiction: 원문 일치 — 허구에 기반

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of ①<u>external</u> factors. These factors may be ②<u>random</u> and misleading. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ harsh(가혹한)는 원문 favorable(유리한)이어야 한다. 특히 유리한 조건(낮은 습도 등) 덕분에 목표를 달성.
det.analysis:
① external: 원문 일치 — 외부 요인
② random: 원문 일치 — 무작위적
③ harsh → favorable: 유리한 조건 ←정답
④ boost: 원문 일치 — 자존감 부양

(A) Your partner was at the top of his <u>game</u>. He performed at his peak level and made every move look easy.

(B) The children played a board <u>game</u> together after dinner. They enjoyed the <u>game</u> so much that they stayed up past bedtime.

det.korean: (A) at the top of his game = 최고의 기량 상태, (B) board game = 보드 게임/놀이.

② climbing performance: 본문 등장이지만 '등반 성과' 자체가 아니라 '공로 인정할 수 있는 것'이 원문
③ something you can take credit for: 원문 일치 ←정답
④ random and misleading: 본문 등장이지만 '무작위이고 오해를 유발하는'은 요인의 특성이지 감정 근거 아님
det.tip: take credit for = ~에 대해 공로를 인정받다

ch: something you can take credit for

questions.passage: Basing your self-worth on climbing performance puts you at the whim of external factors. These factors may be random and misleading. Comparison is one source of illusion. Perhaps you felt that you performed well on a certain climb because your partner was having an off day and found the climbing very difficult. You found it only slightly difficult and conclude that you were climbing quite well, when in fact you were climbing no better than usual. Or, your partner was at the top of his game. You felt weak in comparison, when in fact, objectively, you put in a very strong performance. Environmental factors may be involved. Perhaps you mastered your day's objective due to especially favorable conditions, such as low humidity, when in fact, you really didn't climb particularly well. In all these cases, the good or bad feelings you have are not based on something you can take credit for. If the performances boost your self-worth, __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성과가 자존감을 부양한다면, 그 부양은 허구에 근거(grounded in fiction)한다.
det.analysis:
① you put in a very strong performance: 본문 등장이지만 '강한 성과를 냈다'는 결론 문장 아님
② one source of illusion: 본문 등장이지만 '착각의 원천'은 비교 설명이지 결론 아님
③ at the whim of external factors: 본문 등장이지만 '외부 요인의 변덕에'는 도입부 내용
④ the boost is grounded in fiction: 허구에 근거 — 원문 일치 ←정답
